coordinateConvention: Map metres unchanged. Projected X right, Y down. Native image UV top-left. No art rotation, skew or nonuniform scale.

regionExample.note: Example anchor/scale nominal ONLY, not measured A-v3 alignment. preview-only draws native art; route/rider disabled. ready requires real registration evidence.

optionalRootFields.roads: array of {id,width,nodes:[[mapX,mapY],...]}; independent original-road debug overlay, default hidden
optionalRootFields.displayLOD: Display-only derived overview {file,sha256,nativeSize,pixelsPerUnit,projectedTopLeft,sourceRegionIds,maxTextureSize,evidenceFile}; mandatory when >24 regions. projectedTopLeft uses global canvas-down projected map units, not map XY. Never part of regions/registration/routeCoverage.

registrationContract.ready: At least 3 spread noncollinear observed correspondences {map:[x,y],pixel:[u,v]}, evidence path, finite measured maxResidualPixels; PM explicitly marks ready. Renderer does not solve/warp art.
registrationContract.anchor: anchorUV is measured native image location corresponding to anchorMap. One global uniform nativePixelsPerUnit per image, same camera axes.
registrationContract.ownership: Optional simple non-self-intersecting polygon in native UV, runtime clipping only. PM supplies complementary polygons for overlap ownership; transparent alpha remains intact. Higher sortOrder draws later. Default whole alpha rectangle; no claim of seamlessness.
registrationContract.routeGate: PM explicitly marks region.registration.status ready; route/rider must stay inside blue deliveryPolygon and the union of ready routeCoverageMapPolygon polygons (fallback: image ownership for entries without this optional field). Entire continuous route segments are checked, including boundary crossings; original-road centreline constraints remain. No numerical residual acceptance threshold is imposed by the renderer; PM selects usable corridors and retains measurement evidence.
registrationContract.unavailable: Missing art remains blank with status count; never repeats other region art or draws replacement buildings.
registrationContract.routeCoverageMapPolygon: Optional region.registration.routeCoverageMapPolygon: simple polygon of [mapX,mapY] in original map metres. When supplied, it replaces image ownership as route/rider trust coverage only. It never clips or changes original art. Missing/null retains legacy image-ownership coverage. preview-only never enables route/rider, even when a polygon is supplied.
registrationContract.artTolerance: User accepts small offsets on the order of one or two paving tiles. Do not translate this into a fixed pixel/metre acceptance threshold or reject by global maximum residual. PM selects usable corridors; only obvious coverage/occlusion affecting use needs repair. Source roads, blue boundary and route trust gates remain unchanged.

handoff: PM supplies region-atlas.json plus native images relative to its directory. preparation tool copies byte-identical assets, records SHA. planning/ and registration/ stay data-agent owned.

lodEvidenceContract.sources: Every native region id/file/SHA/anchor/scale/sortOrder/ownership and projected bounds; global projection; generator SHA and Pillow version
lodEvidenceContract.nativePreservation: Original PNG bytes remain unchanged; overview is runtime-only derived RGBA. Unmade space transparent. No repeat/tile fallback.
lodEvidenceContract.mode: Overview only while far or near native set incomplete or >24 candidates; native only once all near candidates loaded. Never overlay a partial native subset over flattened overview.
lodEvidenceContract.budget: One <=2048px overview by default (configurable64..4096); <=24 native live+pending, <=2 concurrent fetches; offscreen delay3s except capacity reclamation.
lodEvidenceContract.integrity: integration-record links PM sourceAtlasSHA, runtime override and LOD/evidence file hashes. LOD source ids must exactly cover native region ids.
